verdict.rationale: Qodo ships an official Agentic Toolbox CLI that runs Qodo-managed skills locally, including reviewing changes before a pull request is opened. That covers the local-diff part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows the CLI running in CI scripts or emitting machine-readable output (such as JSON or SARIF) for other tools to consume, and the CLI evidence consists of short doc snippets only. Missing for 10: documented CI/non-interactive usage, machine-readable output formats, in-depth CLI review docs, independent hands-on corroboration of CLI reviews.
